name: Image
purpose: A photo, screenshot or illustration with a short caption; the image drifts slowly (Ken Burns).
use_when: context.images offers an image that shows what this part of the narration is about
a place, a product, a screen or a team worth seeing
avoid_when: no image was provided: never invent an image reference
a list, steps or a comparison (use their own scene types)

image.desc: A ref from context.images (https URL, upload:<id> or brand:<n>)

alt.desc: What the image shows, for accessibility (not displayed)

full.desc: The image fills the stage; the caption sits on a dark band across its foot

split.desc: The image beside the headline and caption

framed.desc: A framed print, slightly tilted, with the caption beneath

example.alt: A bright, abstract illustration of a shared workspace
example.headline: Where the team meets
example.caption: The third-floor studio is open from 8 to 6, and the corner booth is yours to book.

example_beats.say: This is where the team meets.
The third-floor studio is open from eight to six, and you can book the corner booth.
